state.persona: Anonymous first-time visitor to dope.travel (a travel discovery site), on an iPhone-sized phone, no account, no prior knowledge of the product vocabulary. Wants to find a place worth going to, understand why and how far, and keep it for later.
state.job: Plan an Aspen Christmas ski week with another family and get the plan in front of them.
state.workflow: Tapped Start a trip from the Aspen journey; landed on the Trips page family-ski section on a phone. Reading top to bottom.
visible_in_order_top_to_bottom: First screen: START WITH THE PEOPLE. Plan the snow, together. Begin with two regions and the shape of your trip. Create a Circle, send its link to the other family, then use the private conversation to compare towns and stays.
Steps: 01 Choose a window and what your family needs. 02 Share the Circle link with your friend. 03 Approve their request, then shortlist together.
Privacy note about who sees the Circle name and dates.
RESEARCH BRIEF / AWAITING CONNECTION box with four 'pending' rows.

Only after scrolling about 1.3 phone screens: FAMILY SKI TRIP / FIRST DRAFT. Note: Shared trip rooms aren't available on this preview. Nothing you enter is saved on dope.travel, but you can copy your brief and send it to the other family yourself.
Form (prefilled Aspen, 19 Dec 2026 - 3 Jan 2027) and, about 3 screens down, the button Copy our trip brief.

expects_circle_link.instructions: Probability that, after the first screen, the user expects dope.travel to create a shareable Circle link for the other family.

notices_unavailable_before_filling.instructions: Probability the user understands that shared trip rooms are unavailable before they start filling in the form.

clarity.instructions: How clear is the path to getting the plan to the other family?
criteria: Misleading: promises a shared link that cannot be made
Unclear until deep in the page

legend.0: Misleading: promises a shared link that cannot be made
legend.1: Unclear until deep in the page
